input_text: Bookshop-chain heir Armaan rides a bicycle as a courier for a week to see how his readers live. He falls for Sia, who runs a failing second-hand bookstore. A property developer wants her land and tries to force her to close. Armaan secretly buys the developer's loan so he must back off. Sia finds the papers and suspects Armaan of spying on her. After a fierce quarrel he confesses who he is and she leaves. He reopens the bookstore in her name.
